## Summary

Describe the user-visible and implementation changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has regression coverage.
- [ ] API, user guide, architecture, and known limitations were updated where applicable.
- [ ] No token, credential, raw session content, or private path was committed.
- [ ] File-writing behavior preserves copy-on-write, trash, and pre-restore safety guarantees.

## Risk
